versions.changelog:
**Improved observability and safety; streamlined usage.**

- Added user-agent generation script for consistent API tracking and observability.
- Updated prerequisite checks: Aliyun CLI and credential checks apply only to actual cloud operations, not offline log-sample processing.
- Reinforced security rules, removing AI-Mode usage and any recommendation to set user-agent via CLI config.
- Clarified routing and safety for automatic index discovery; preserve `line.auto_text_keys` unless explicitly changed.
- Removed and reorganized documents for clarity; updated internal references.

alibabacloud-sls-index-config-management v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Provides management of Alibaba Cloud SLS (Simple Log Service) Logstore index configurations via aliyun CLI.
- Supports inspecting, creating, updating, deleting, generating, and optimizing index configuration.
- Requires AI mode enablement and credential/security checks before operations.
- Outputs both complete JSON and human-readable summaries for all index configurations.
- Includes detailed routing to relevant reference guides for each scenario.
